text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—Rounding the fourth corner!! Onto the 
homestretch!!!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —WOOOOOOAAHHH!!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Ngh!?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
(This is————this feeling is...!! There is 
no doubt, the chains of destiny...!)

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
(Not good! At this rate, I'll get boxed in 
and swallowed up...!!)

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —Am I... going to lose...?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Absolutely not!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
I deny you right here, right now! Shatter 
to pieces!! My former, hypothetical 
destiny!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (SKREEEEEECH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —HAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAH!!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Tanino Gimlet accelerates!! Tanino 
Gimlet!! It's Tanino Gimlet————!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
In the lead is Tanino Gimlet!! She did 
it!! Across the finish line!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Oooooooh! What insane acceleration! That's 
incredible! For real, she could totally 
take the Derby too!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"Too crazy...!! I've got total 
goosebumps...!! How could you NOT stan 
this!?"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ――So cool...!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
She seriously blew everything away with 
her run...!! The whole crowd... and even 
all my anxiety... everything!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"If you keep this up, Senpai, I'm sure you 
can do it in the Derby too...!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —I heard it. Loud and clear.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
That sweet, exquisite sound of severing 
the chains of fate...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh... Hahaha... Hahahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Bwaaa-hahahaha!!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Rejoice! Everyone here has just witnessed 
the moment reason itself was destroyed!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"And feast your eyes!! My next act of 
destruction will be the Nippon Derby!!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
And there, I promise to bring about even 
greater frenzy and destruction!!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: (Gimlet!! Lady Gimlet!!)

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Heh—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having brilliantly conquered the fierce 
battle and proven her "swiftness," I 
returned to the waiting room with Tanino 
Gimlet—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tanino Gimlet suddenly dropped to her 
knees. Looking closely, her face and whole 
body were clearly overcome with intense 
exhaustion...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"...No cause for concern. My mind is 
clear. I feel no pain. Though... my body 
is a bit heavy."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"A price to pay, is it? Overturning the 
chains of fate is indeed no easy task...!"
choice_data_list: Let me see your leg, just in case...!
Let me see your leg, just in case...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Understood—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Fortunately, Tanino Gimlet's legs showed 
no serious abnormalities. However, the 
exhaustion from a fierce battle was 
clearly evident...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"To ensure there were no lingering 
effects, I immediately used the tools and 
methods I had prepared to treat Tanino 
Gimlet's legs."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh. A magnificent display of skill. 
It was as though you were blessed by the 
goddess of healing herself.
choice_data_list:
Just to be safe, let's get a thorough 
examination done after this.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. We must act as lions. Any seed of 
calamity ought to be nipped in the bud.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ...I thank you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Today, I defied the encroaching destiny 
and seized victory with my own hands.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
It is none other than your drunkenness 
towards me—or perhaps the aid born of your 
madness...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Continue to wield that fervor! And I shall 
fuel my soul with that very fervor, 
transforming it into my own ruinous 
brilliance!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—The ultimate high, found only at the 
Derby.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Yes. I have high expectations for you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...A few days after the 'NHK Mile Cup.' 
While Tanino Gimlet's thorough medical 
examination confirmed nothing was wrong—

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
“――Well now, what a spectacular 
performance in the NHK Mile Cup! But 
because of that, it does leave one a bit 
worried about the challenge that is the 
Derby~”

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
"‘Will she be able to fully recover from 
her fatigue in the short time before her 
next race? That will certainly be a key 
point to watch!’"

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
"It's a rotation that includes the Satsuki 
Sho after all. From our side, we're really 
on edge worrying that she might end up 
getting injured."

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
"On social media as well, while many 
express high hopes for Tanino Gimlet's 
success, numerous voices are also 
concerned about the toll consecutive 
fierce battles might take on her body—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...There were still many anxious voices 
among the public regarding Tanino Gimlet's 
challenge in the Tokyo Yushun (Japanese 
Derby).

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Some firmly believe that running in the 
NHK Mile Cup was premature, and it's 
undeniable that she's facing harsh 
scrutiny."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"—If it's her, she'll surely blow away all 
the adversity through her results. ...Of 
course, I am fully prepared for that as 
well."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the other hand, part of her must resent 
that the crowd's excessive worry keeps 
them from truly getting swept up in her 
running...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case, it wouldn't be 
surprising if Tanino Gimlet took some kind 
of action to intoxicate the masses.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —Oh? An open training session, I see...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I nod in agreement. By deliberately making 
her Japanese Derby training public on a 
large scale, the goal is to show everyone 
she's in top form.
choice_data_list:
Of course, with a reasonable training 
routine, though.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tanino Gimlet is prioritizing recovery for 
the Derby right now. Because of that, we 
should avoid intense training...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"That will all come down to how we execute 
it. Very well. Let us waste no time 
looking into implementing this!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Even so... Heheh...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
How could I not laugh?! To think you'd 
arrive at the exact same conclusion as 
me...!
choice_data_list: So Gimlet was thinking about it too...!
So Gimlet was thinking about it too...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—If the audience is burdened with needless 
worry before the curtain even rises and 
cannot focus on the stage, the magic is 
ruined—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"If my existence is the causality 
gathering dark clouds, then inevitably, I 
am also the one who shall disperse them 
and display my brilliance."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"By doing so, we will once again make a 
grand display of who everyone should be 
watching! ...That's your line of thinking, 
right?"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —A fine sort of madness.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And then came the day of the public 
training session—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —HAAAH!!

text_block_list.name: Visiting Reporters
text_block_list.text: (Ooohh...!!)

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Impressive...! It looks like she's already 
completely recovered from the fatigue of 
the NHK Mile Cup!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
"So Tanino Gimlet really is the 
favorite...! I need to revise the article 
right away!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh... That's it, let the fever rise 
higher...! Toward my destined race...!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
"Tanino Gimlet seems completely unfazed by 
her grueling schedule heading into the 
Derby! What an overwhelmingly powerful 
performance!"

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
""Seeing this really makes you want to 
cheer for her wholeheartedly. We can look 
forward to seeing a powerful run from her 
in the Derby as well.""

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"—This attempt bore fruit, and the voices 
cheering on Tanino Gimlet's challenge grew 
noticeably louder...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The final destination of the MC rotation. 
The decisive battle, the "Japanese Derby", 
is near――
